A prayer which increases [[faith]] by 50%/100%/150% and donations by 20%. It can be crafted at the [[Desk]] or [[Desk II]]. The quality is dependent on the ingredients and for the sermon to be successful it needs  10{{Church Rating}}/20{{Church Rating}}/50{{Church Rating}}.
